parts:
Hello again,

I am experiencing an error when trying to pass a list to rhlapply. It
works just fine if I pass just a number but the list gives me the
following error. Here is my code:

> weights.NVaR = rhex(rhlapply(ll=list(101,102,103,104,105,110,113,114,115,116),fun = rollNVaR,setup=expression({ load("session.Rdata", .GlobalEnv)}), shared=("/tmp/session.Rdata"),aggr=function(x) do.call("rbind",x),mapred=list(mapred.task.timeout=3600000,mapred.map.tasks=120)))
Creating temporary input folder for list
Error in if (is.null(N) || N == 0 || N > length(lo)) N <-
length(lo) :
missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
Error in unlink(tmf) : object "tmf" not found

I'm running Rhipe 0.59.

Thanks in advance for your help!

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Error in unlink(tmf) : object "tmf" not found
parts:
Hi,
I'm away from a proper internet connection, so I'll try and help, but it'll be Sunday(23rd) before I'll be back un the US.

Nevertheless
a) are you running on EC2?
b) also could you tell me the output of rhoptions()$version

If the answer to (a) is yes, this is because rhwrite tries to 'intelligently' break your list into N chunks each of size ~ (length of list)/N (each chunk is a map task), where N is determined from the following fragment:

 if (is.null(N)) {
        x1 <- rhoptions()$mropts$mapred.map.tasks
        x2 <- rhoptions()$mropts$mapred.tasktracker.map.tasks.maximum
        N <- as.numeric(x1) * as.numeric(x2)
    }

On EC2 if I recall correctly, rhoptions()$mropts$mapred.map.tasks is missing. Hence rhlapply fails. What you can do to fix this is
call rhlapply and pass it the N option

> weights.NVaR = rhex(rhlapply(ll=list(101,102,103,104,105,110,113,114,115,116),fun = rollNVaR,setup=expression({ load("session.Rdata", .GlobalEnv)}), N= 120, shared=("/tmp/session.Rdata"),aggr=function(x) do.call("rbind",x),mapred=list(mapred.task.timeout=3600000)))


Ideally, rhlapply should have picked up your mapred.map.tasks and used that. I'll include it next version.

Tell me if this works.
Cheers
Saptarshi
